name: Aisyah Rahman
bio:
Aisyah's journey into motorsport began unexpectedly. A gifted student excelling in mathematics and physics, she initially pursued a career in aerospace engineering, drawn to the complexities of flight. However, a chance encounter with a Formula 1 aerodynamicist at a university career fair sparked a new passion. Fascinated by the application of aerodynamic principles to racing cars, she shifted her focus, landing a junior position at a small European racing team. 

Her approach to leading the aero department is data-driven and meticulous. Aisyah believes in fostering a collaborative environment where innovative ideas are encouraged but rigorously tested. She is known for her relentless pursuit of marginal gains and her ability to translate complex aerodynamic concepts into practical solutions that improve on-track performance. What sets her apart is her ability to blend her Malaysian heritage with a strong European work ethic, resulting in a unique perspective on problem-solving and team dynamics.

physical.hairStyle: long, straight, usually tied back in a practical ponytail
physical.description: Aisyah is of average height with a focused and intense gaze.

quirks: Always carries a small notebook filled with equations and sketches.
Has a habit of tapping her pen against her teeth when deep in thought.
Insists on using metric units for everything, even when working with British engineers.
